response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience, deep systems thinking, and exposure to agentic tooling at re:cinq, but lacks clear evidence of distributed systems ownership at scale, Python mastery, or direct AI-native engineering experience — key for this role. His open-source contributions and operational depth are strengths, but the resume omits concrete metrics, on-call experience, and stakeholder coordination at staff level.
strengths: Exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators at re:cinq
Demonstrated systems thinking across embedded, web, and distributed systems
Strong operational history with CI/CD, Kubernetes, and open-source tooling
concerns: No explicit Python expertise listed despite it being a must-have
Lacks clear evidence of leading technical strategy or owning high-throughput distributed systems
No mention of incident response, on-call rotation, or agile scrum champion experience
